semiconductor_relevance: High — TRI specializes in advanced test and inspection systems crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Test Research, Inc. (TRI) is a leading provider of test and inspection solutions for the electronics manufacturing industry, focusing on advanced packaging and back-end inspection systems. Their offerings include high-precision inspection solutions that support various semiconductor applications, ensuring quality and yield improvements.
